value.answer: Ear tugging plus overnight crying in a toddler often points to an ear infection or fluid buildup, sometimes after a cold. Many mild ear infections improve on their own in a day or two - watch for fever, pulling worse on one side, fussiness with feeding, or fluid draining from the ear.
value.triage: Call 811 (Health811) today if crying continues, fever appears, or you want it checked - a nurse can advise on pain relief and whether antibiotics may be needed. Go to the ER or call 911 now if there is high fever with stiff neck, swelling/redness behind the ear, drainage of pus or blood, trouble waking, or breathing difficulty.
value.sources: HealthyChildren.org (AAP), Caring for Kids (Canadian Paediatric Society)
